_comment: Website domain — ready-to-run deploy config. The GOAL is operator data: set site_goal (and optional constraints) here — the pack is only the mechanism. Provider keys via .env.
_site_goal_comment: THE goal the site is developed toward — free text, rendered into every prompt. This example is the nutrition test scenario from the spec.
site_goal: Build a simple healthy nutrition site: ingredients, and simple meals that are fast to make (sample: put in a bowl, heat up, ready), with good nutrient combinations per meal, cheap where possible (price is lower priority).
_constraints_comment: Brand/CI invariants the model must respect (string or list of lines); rendered into every prompt — SOFT enforcement (taste, wording, anything unmechanical).
constraints: Plain HTML/CSS/JS only — no frameworks, no build step.
Keep style.css as the single shared stylesheet.
Dark background with warm accent colors (orange/gold); green only where it means success.
_hard_constraints_comment: HARD enforcement — checked inside the write actions, a violating action fails with status=error (logged, and fed back to the model next run). forbidden_colors: substrings refused anywhere in a stylesheet. required_snippets: must survive an edit of a page that already contained them. Both are opt-in (empty = nothing to violate). allow_hotlinking is a FLOOR, active even without this block: false refuses so images must be downloaded via add_asset; set true to opt out.
_assets_comment: add_asset licensing ladder. allowed_hosts: operator-approved hosts (incl. subdomains) whose files may be downloaded regardless of license — your own CDN, logo host. Anything else must carry an open license (by, by-sa, cc0, pdm) from the image_search tool. max_bytes caps one download.
_connector_comment: pages mode: fixed URL list, captured via read_url (Jina Reader) each run; snippet id = url#hash so a CHANGED page re-ingests and an unchanged one is skipped. A run is noop without new input, so list at least one source page. The model can additionally research on its own during analyze (web_search/read_url tools).
_metrics_comment: Active metric modules (domain_pack/metrics/<name>.py). Custom: drop a module file in there and add its name here. goal_coverage is LLM-judged (one model call per run).
_allow_list_comment: Autonomous default: everything allow-listed, git is the undo. Drop an action from this list to HOLD it for human approval instead (e.g. remove "remove_page" if deletions should be reviewed); empty list = every action holds.
_analyze_tool_steps_comment: agentic analyze: max tool calls (read_page/read_url/web_search) per run; 0 = one-shot
_git_comment: Git versioning of the site — REQUIRED for autonomy: edit_content, change_design and remove_page are honestly reversible=false, so the gate only auto-runs them while git makes them recoverable (enabled + per_action + repo healthy/clean). PRE-INITIALIZE: `git init` inside data/site, commit the seed. Set remote to also push (e.g. to a hosting repo); empty = local-only. If git is unavailable/dirty, those actions safely HOLD for approval instead.
